reviews.author: Jocelyn Hernandez
reviews.text:
Jacobo is an outstanding drum instructor! My son is 8 years old and has been taking lessons with him for about 10 months, and the growth we've seen has been incredible. Jacobo meets my son exactly where he is developmentally and tailors each lesson to his skill level while keeping them engaging and fun. Even in a virtual setting, he does an amazing job of holding my son's attention with interactive activities and enjoyable practice assignments my son actually looks forward to completing.

Beyond the technical skills he's gained, I've watched my son's confidence, love for music, and understanding of rhythm and musical notation grow tremendously. Jacobo is patient, encouraging, and truly passionate about teaching. We are so grateful for the positive impact he's had on my son's musical journey and highly recommend him to anyone looking for an exceptional drum instructor!

reviews.author: Li-Yang Hsu
reviews.text: I’ve been learning drums and music theory with Jacobo since 2021 and it’s been absolutely amazing! He had me focused on crucial elements of music and build a solid foundation on my rhythmic feel over the years.

reviews.author: Naomrtz
reviews.text: I had an awesome first drum lesson! Jacobo was thorough, covering everything from reading music to teaching me my first drum beat. We also went over technique, which was super helpful. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Nisaa Reed
reviews.text: I recently started drumming, and going into it, I was very anxious since this was something completely new to me. However, Jacob made me feel comfortable from the very first lesson. He was incredibly patient and understanding, knowing it was my first time ever playing the drums. If you’re looking for a drum instructor who is kind, patient, and supportive, I highly recommend taking lessons with Jacabo!!!

reviews.author: Joseph Ortiz
reviews.text: My experience working with Jacobo was great. The exercises he writes really helped me with my flow. He is a drummer first and a teacher second, so everything he teaches comes from a practical base of knowledge and mastery.
